facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that since December 2021 the DGI online registration platform issues an IFU in under 24 hours from the NPI.
La Marina BJ reports the DGI issues the IFU from the ANIP-issued NPI and has matched its IFU file against the RNPP; 439,333 of 1,077,679 IFU were attached to an NPI on 25 October 2023.
